phrase.zh: 一条线，也能试探一个世界。
phrase.en: A line can explore a world.

visual.zh: 克利的生成肖像与细线、几何块面组成尚在生长的图形。画面把线条当作探索的路径，不是克利原作，短句也不是他的名言。
visual.en: A generated Klee portrait, fine lines and geometric planes form a growing visual structure. Lines become paths of exploration. This is neither an original Klee work nor a quotation from him.

background.zh: 保罗·克利中心的研究档案包含他的日记、手写作品目录和包豪斯教学笔记。这些不同材料说明，绘画创作、记录与教学可以彼此联系。读一条线的意义时，也可以把它放回长期练习和研究的过程。
background.en: The Zentrum Paul Klee archive includes diaries, a handwritten catalogue of works and Bauhaus teaching notes. These materials connect making, recording and teaching. A line can thus be considered within an extended practice of experimentation rather than only as a finished decorative mark.

sources.label: Zentrum Paul Klee · Archive and research
